observations.claim: Findability is the complaint the managing director hears most; the file layer was migrated 18 months ago without reorganisation.
observations.quote: We moved everything into Filestead eighteen months ago and it's a skip, not a filing cabinet.

observations.claim: The same figures are keyed into multiple systems as a quote becomes a booking becomes an invoice.
observations.quote: A quote becomes a booking becomes an invoice and I'm fairly sure the same numbers get keyed into three systems on the way.

observations.claim: AI assistant spend is visible and rising; usage cannot be attributed to people, teams or outcomes.
observations.quote: The bill turns up, it's gone up again, and nobody can tell me whose usage that is or what it saved.

scale.load: roughly 60 assistant seats ("must be sixty-odd seats now")

observations.claim: The weekly margin pack is hand-built and errors in it surface mid-week while pricing decisions rest on it.
observations.quote: by Wednesday I find out a number in it was wrong
observations.stated_dependencies: But I'm making pricing calls on it.

observations.claim: A CRM migration is in flight (pipeline half moved off spreadsheets); a TMS upgrade is discussed but unscheduled.
observations.quote: We're moving the sales pipeline off spreadsheets into Tallybook, that's half done.

observations.claim: The sponsor's estimate of quote effort is about 20 minutes (second-hand about the sales desk; contradicted by the sales lead's own account).
observations.quote: Sales will tell you a quote takes about 20 minutes.
